 Cruïlla 
 Cruïlla 2027: 7 to 10 July at the Fòrum, with €125 and €105 passes and the line-up still to be announced
 Redacción ModoFestival · Editor: Clara Belmonte 
 15 Nov 2026, 11:30 
 A 3-minute read 
 Festival Cruïlla 
 Follow us on Google 
 In short
 Cruïlla 2027 will run from Wednesday 7 to Saturday 10 July at Parc del Fòrum , four days, with not a single name on the line-up announced yet. 
 The four-day pass costs €125 and the weekend pass €105, plus fees ; no day tickets are on sale and the press suggests the price will rise in tiers. 
 The Premium pass goes up to €320 for the four days , with fast-track entry, a dedicated area with a bar and a raised platform facing the main stage. 
 Cruïlla already has dates and passes for 2027, although it has yet to say who will be playing. The Barcelona festival will take place from 7 to 10 July 2027 at Parc del Fòrum and has been selling two general passes since the summer: the four-day pass, at €125 , and the weekend pass, at €105 , with fees charged separately in both cases.
 Festival guide 
 Cruïlla 2027 
 7–10 Jul 2027 · Parc del Fòrum, Barcelona 
 Tickets 
 Disponibles 
 7 to 10 July, once again at the Fòrum
 Cruïlla repeats its four-day format at Parc del Fòrum, from Wednesday 7 to Saturday 10 July . The official website already shows the 2027 dates, although some text on the tickets page still carries the 2026 ones (8 to 11 July): the correct dates are 7 to 10.
 There is nothing on the line-up. In 2026, the festival brought together Pixies, David Byrne, Faithless, The Black Crowes, The Hives, Rigoberta Bandini, Garbage, Two Door Cinema Club, Suede, Jon Batiste and Jovanotti, and Barcelona Secreta put the number of people who attended across its four days at 73,000. Anyone buying now does so without knowing who will play, in exchange for the current price.
 The Cruïlla crowd at Parc del Fòrum in 2017. Image: Roger Canals / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) Passes at €125 and €105, no day tickets
 These are the two general passes on sale on the festival's website:
 Full pass (7 to 10 July): €125 plus €12.50 in fees, €137.50 in total.
 Weekend pass (Friday 9 and Saturday 10): €105 plus €10.50 in fees, €115.50 in total.
 Per day, the full pass works out at just over €34 including fees and the weekend pass at almost €58. So if you plan to go for three or four days, the full pass is by far the better deal. No day tickets are on sale, and the festival has not said when they will be released.
 Official tickets are sold through the Cruïlla tickets page . The same passes are also sold on Fever, at the same price: the full pass and the weekend pass . ModoFestival may receive a commission if you buy through these links, at no extra cost to you.
 Barcelona Secreta, which reported the release of the passes in July, said the price would rise in tiers. The festival has not published how many passes remain at this price or when it will change, so there is no deadline that can be taken as certain.
 The Premium pass: €320 for the four days
 For those who want to watch the concerts in greater comfort, Cruïlla sells Premium passes: €320 plus €32 in fees for the four days and €250 plus €25 for the weekend. They include fast-lane entry, a welcome drink, an exclusive area with a bar, free parking with advance booking and a raised platform facing the Estrella Damm stage, the main one.
 In our comparison of 2027 festival pass prices , Cruïlla is one of the cheapest per day thanks to its four days. Everything that already has a date this summer is in the July to September 2027 festival calendar , and information about the festival is on the Cruïlla page .
 Sources: official Cruïlla website (tickets and Premium passes), accessed on 15 November 2026; Barcelona Secreta (23 July 2026); La Ganzúa; Fever catalogue.
